mapper.insert: insert into user_coupon (user_id, coupon_id, status, use_time, order_id, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{useTime}, #{orderId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from user_coupon where user_id = #{userId} order by id desc

select c.* from user_coupon uc join coupon c on c.id = uc.coupon_id where uc.user_id = #{userId} and uc.status = 0 and c.status = 1 and (c.min_amount is null or c.min_amount <= #{amount}) and (c.start_time is null or c.start_time <= now()) and (c.end_time is null or c.end_time >= now()) order by c.value desc, uc.id desc
